title: carduus pycnocephalus var. acicularis
intro: Carduus pycnocephalus var. acicularis, commonly known as prickly thistle or thistle with needle-like leaves, is a plant species within the Asteraceae family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues, thanks to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Carduus pycnocephalus var. acicularis include anti-inflammatory, diuretic, and expectorant properties, which can aid in the treatment of various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, sesquiterpene lactones, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
